issues.display_title: Issue #1906: refactor(api): remove deprecated _go parameter and legacy fallback in fetchDataFromApi
issues.main_description_html:
Description

The migration of API endpoints to the Go backend has been completed. All callers of fetchDataFromApi explicitly pass _go: true. Consequently, the legacy fallback branch utilizing environment.baseURL and environment.baseURL_GET is dead code.

This issue tracks simplifying fetchDataFromApi by removing the _go parameter and resolving directly to the Go backend base URL (baseURL_go / baseURL_GET_go).

Scope of Changes

  1. MainService (src/app/shared/services/main.service.ts):
    • Remove _go parameter from the fetchDataFromApi signature and destructuring.
    • Remove the if (_go) branching logic; resolve base_host directly via this.isBrowser ? environment.baseURL_go : environment.baseURL_GET_go.
  2. Caller Cleanup:
    • Remove _go: true from all 7 call sites:
      • src/app/shared/services/main.service.ts (getUserProfile)
      • src/app/pages/settings/settings.service.ts (checkUserHavePassword)
      • src/app/pages/settings/billing/billing.service.ts (getSubscriptionOverview, getBillingInfo)
      • src/app/pages/promocodes/promocodes.service.ts (getPromoCodes, getPromoCode)
      • src/app/pages/virtual-gallery/editor/editor.service.ts (getFrameTemplate)

Acceptance Criteria

  • fetchDataFromApi signature and implementation updated without the _go parameter.
  • All call sites cleaned up and no longer pass _go: true.
  • No regressions in API routing across browser and SSR modes.
  • Test suites and build checks pass successfully.

issues.display_title: Issue #1912: perf: Optimize Lighthouse Audit Scores and Core Web Vitals across Public Pages
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Optimize Lighthouse audit scores across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO for public-facing routes (Homepage, Pricing, Catalogue, Blog, etc.) to enhance user experience, search discoverability, and Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, and TBT).

Background & Problems

  1. Initial Load & Core Web Vitals:
    • Initial JavaScript bundle size and render-blocking stylesheets increase First Contentful Paint (FCP) and Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).
    • Third-party tracking and analytics scripts (such as Countly, Google tags) execute during initial page load rather than deferring until idle time.
    • Heavy hero assets and dynamic elements can cause layout thrashing and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
  2. Accessibility:
    • Minor heading hierarchy mismatches and missing accessible names on icon buttons lower the accessibility audit score.
  3. Best Practices:
    • Deprecated attributes or unoptimized image dimensions without explicit aspect ratios impact the Best Practices category.
  4. SEO & Crawlability:
    • Opportunities exist to refine meta tag structures and link texts to achieve a consistent 100 SEO score across all public routes.

Scope of Improvements

  1. Critical Rendering Path & Asset Optimization:
    • Defer non-critical stylesheets and heavy third-party tracking scripts to run after initial paint / during idle time.
    • Implement font stability and font-display: swap to prevent layout shifts and FOIT (Flash of Invisible Text).
    • Lazy-load below-the-fold widgets, modals, and embedded media.
  2. Accessibility Compliance:
    • Standardize heading structures across page sections.
    • Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) contain valid and unique accessible names (aria-label).
  3. Best Practices & Layout Stability:
    • Define explicit dimensions/aspect ratios on images and video placeholders to achieve zero CLS.
    • Resolve console deprecation warnings and modernize legacy web APIs.
  4. Audit Target:
    • Achieve 90+ Performance score and 100 in Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO categories.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Lighthouse Performance score reaches 90+ on desktop/mobile for public pages.
  • Lighthouse Accessibility score reaches 95+ (target: 100).
  • Lighthouse Best Practices reaches 100.
  • Lighthouse SEO reaches 100.
  • Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) remains < 0.1 on initial load and navigation.
  • Non-essential third-party scripts do not block initial thread execution.
  • SSR and production build complete cleanly without regressions.
